newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Delay in Yeltsin op boosts survival chance - doctor.
newsitem.headline: Delay in Yeltsin op boosts survival chance - doctor.

text.p: Delaying President Boris Yeltsin's planned heart operation by 6-8 weeks should greatly increase the president's chances of surviving surgery, Russian cardiologist Renat Akchurin told a news briefing.

"If we operate now, I would say the chance is about 80 percent, but we hope that in six weeks the percentage would be close to 100," Akchurin said. He was speaking after a council of doctors decided to delay the heart surgery for 6-8 weeks in order to prepare the president for the operation.
